2.web: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
2.asv: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.

3.web: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
3.asv: Suffer me, and I also will speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.

4.web: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
4.asv: As for me, is my complaint to man? And why should I not be impatient?

5.web: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
5.asv: Mark me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.

6.web: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
6.asv: Even when I remember I am troubled, And horror taketh hold on my flesh.

7.web: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
7.asv: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?

8.web: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
8.asv: Their seed is established with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes.

9.web: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
9.asv: Their houses are safe from fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.

10.web: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
10.asv: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

11.web: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
11.asv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.

12.web: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
12.asv: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

13.web: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
13.asv: They spend their days in prosperity, And in a moment they go down to Sheol.

14.web: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
14.asv: And they say unto God, Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

15.web: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
15.asv: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

16.web: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
16.asv: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand: The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

17.web: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
17.asv: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? ThatGod distributeth sorrows in his anger?

18.web: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
18.asv: That they are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm carrieth away?

19.web: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
19.asv: Ye say, God layeth up his iniquity for his children. Let him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it:

20.web: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
20.asv: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

21.web: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
21.asv: For what careth he for his house after him, When the number of his months is cut off?

22.web: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
22.asv: Shall any teach God knowledge, Seeing he judgeth those that are high?

23.web: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
23.asv: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet:

24.web: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
24.asv: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.

25.web: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
25.asv: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And never tasteth of good.

26.web: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
26.asv: They lie down alike in the dust, And the worm covereth them.

27.web: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the devices with which you would wrong me.
27.asv: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices wherewith ye would wrong me.

28.web: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
28.asv: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?

29.web: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
29.asv: Have ye not asked wayfaring men? And do ye not know their evidences,

30.web: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
30.asv: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity? That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

31.web: Who shall declare his way to his face? Who shall repay him what he has done?
31.asv: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?

32.web: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men shall keep watch over the tomb.
32.asv: Yet shall he be borne to the grave, And men shall keep watch over the tomb.

33.web: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him. All men shall draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
33.asv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, And all men shall draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.

34.web: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
34.asv: How then comfort ye me in vain, Seeing in your answers there remaineth only falsehood?
